activationGate: After explicit approval: bootstrap-only permits only manual bootstrap; true permits scheduled samples after bootstrap succeeds
epoch: One create-only manual bootstrap; fixed seven-day deadline; no automatic reset
canonicalState: State branch with CAS reservation before collection and CAS checkpoint after collection
nativeOpeningNotification: One failed-job intent for each new incident; delivery requires explicit human receipt
infrastructureFailure: BLOCKED and failed job, possibly repeated native failure emails
recovery: Successful job summary; explicit human recovery-summary receipt; no forced failure
